salvage_rules._comment: The set could not break anything down at all before this: `salvage` was enabled and no rule existed for any item, so every attempt refused. A part strips into the scrap the whole station is made of, and so does the gear -- a heavier thing yields more of it. `default_item_id` is what an item with no rule of its own comes back as, which is also why nothing here needs to alias the same output three times: the templates that want something else say so on themselves.

status._comment: The engine's default stat list carries the derived stats of a spellcasting set. This one has none of those, so it says what it shows.
